inputs_read: research/strategy_lab/fz_v3/BRIEF.md (first paragraph: the user's words; H1-H5 text)
research/strategy_lab/FZ.md sections 7, 8, 9 and 19 (what the card reads mean)
author: blind LLM hypothesis proposer (DESIGN_PANEL deep-sequence-llm-hypotheses, round 0)

rule_grammar.if: conjunction of at most 3 comparisons [column, op, value] on as-of columns of features.parquet
rule_grammar.atr_unit: columns ending _atr are in units of atr14 at the SETUP bar
rule_grammar.hour_convention: 1h = 60 bars on minute, 12 bars on 5minute; 3h = 180 / 36 bars

minute.reason: "if CHoCH and CHoCH and no breaks then it's sideways; trades in sideways are hurting"
minute.expected: skipped SETUPs have lower mean Foundation net than kept ones; most skipped are stop_loss / small next_choch exits; few winners of size lost
minute.reading: Two or more CHoCHs since the last BOS and price has covered at most 2 ATR since the SETUP's own CHoCH: the market flips without breaking; skip.

minute.reason: "CHoCH and CHoCH and no breaks" - three flips in a row and nothing broke in the last hour
minute.expected: skipped set is concentrated in losers (fast reversals, next_choch exits); kept-vs-skipped expectancy difference positive
minute.reading: The last three engine events are all CHoCHs and there has been no BOS in the last 60 bars: a flip-flop with no follow-through; skip.

minute.reason: sideways: the last events keep changing direction and the last hour's closes went nowhere ("trades in sideways are hurting")
minute.expected: skipped SETUPs net negative on average; winners skipped are small (no room to run when the hour is inefficient)
minute.reading: Among the last six events direction changed at least four times and the Kaufman efficiency ratio of the last hour is 0.3 or less: chop; skip.

minute.reason: "else price retests, retests and respects" - a SETUP inside a room, on a revisit that is not accepted, pointing at the room edge less than one ATR away
minute.expected: skipped trades mostly die inside the room (stop or next CHoCH before the edge breaks); large winners rarely start from a THIN / RECYCLE read at the edge
minute.reading: The card reads RECYCLE or THIN (a revisit of a known room without conviction) and the nearest room edge ahead is within 1 ATR: the entry is a bet on breaking a respected edge from inside; skip.

minute.reason: "check how price reacts in visibly high volume ... if it breaks there will be a large move" - a SETUP against the last visibly-high-volume bar fades that move
minute.expected: skipped SETUPs (fading the high-volume bar within the hour) lose more often than kept ones; kept SETUPs in agreement keep the large moves
minute.reading: Within the last 60 bars of this session a bar printed at least 3x the prior median volume in the opposite direction to the SETUP: the SETUP trades against the visibly high-volume move; skip.

minute.reason: "Those levels will be respected ... price retests, retests and respects" - the swing ahead was just tested and held
minute.expected: skipped SETUPs run into the held level and reverse (stop or next_choch); the winners lost are few because a level that just held rarely gives way on the very next approach
minute.reading: The last touch of a swing level in the past hour was verdict held, and the swing ahead in the SETUP's direction is within 1 ATR: the entry needs a level that just proved itself to fail; skip.

minute.reason: "it's different for different time" - the midday hours combined with today's own CHoCH-without-break count
minute.expected: the midday sideways SETUPs are net negative; kept midday SETUPs (after a BOS) keep the trend continuations
minute.reading: SETUP bar opens in the 12:xx or 13:xx hour and this session already has two or more CHoCHs since its last BOS: midday chop; skip.

minute.reason: sideways day: an hour into the session nothing has broken and the day range is narrow ("if ... no breaks then it's sideways")
minute.expected: skipped SETUPs come from narrow, break-less sessions and average a loss; kept SETUPs from days that have broken keep the runners
minute.reading: At least 60 bars into the session, no BOS today and the session range so far is at most 2.5 ATR: a range day with no break; skip.

5minute.reason: "if CHoCH and CHoCH and no breaks then it's sideways" - on 5 min two CHoCHs span hours, so the range of the last 3 hours is the width of the box
5minute.expected: skipped SETUPs have lower mean net than kept; the skipped set is mostly next_choch / stop_loss exits inside the box
5minute.reading: Two or more CHoCHs since the last BOS and the last 3 hours (36 bars) of this session span at most 4 ATR: sideways; skip.

5minute.reason: "CHoCH and CHoCH and no breaks" - three flips in a row and no BOS in three hours
5minute.expected: skipped set concentrated in losers; kept-vs-skipped expectancy positive
5minute.reading: The last three events are all CHoCHs and there was no BOS in the last 36 bars: flip-flop with no follow-through; skip.

5minute.reason: sideways: alternating event directions and an inefficient last hour ("trades in sideways are hurting")
5minute.expected: skipped SETUPs net negative on average; small winners lost only
5minute.reading: Direction changed at least four times in the last six events and the last hour's (12 bars) efficiency ratio is 0.35 or less: chop; skip.

5minute.reason: "price retests, retests and respects" - a revisit without acceptance, aimed at a room edge less than one ATR away
5minute.expected: skipped trades die inside the room; large winners rarely start from a THIN / RECYCLE read at the edge
5minute.reading: The card reads RECYCLE or THIN and the nearest room edge ahead is within 1 ATR: a bet on breaking a respected edge from inside; skip.

5minute.reason: "check how price reacts in visibly high volume ... if it breaks there will be a large move" - a SETUP against the last visibly-high-volume 5-min bar within the hour fades it
5minute.expected: skipped SETUPs (fading the high-volume bar) lose more often than kept ones; kept SETUPs in agreement keep the large moves
5minute.reading: Within the last 12 bars of this session a bar printed at least 3x the prior median volume in the opposite direction to the SETUP; skip.

5minute.reason: "Those levels will be respected ... retests, retests and respects" - the swing ahead was just tested and held
5minute.expected: skipped SETUPs run into the held level and reverse; few winners lost
5minute.reading: The last touch of a swing level in the past hour held, and the swing ahead in the SETUP's direction is within 1 ATR; skip.

5minute.reason: "it's different for different time" - midday hours with today's own CHoCH-without-break count
5minute.expected: midday sideways SETUPs are net negative; kept midday SETUPs after a BOS keep the continuations
5minute.reading: SETUP bar opens at 12:xx or 13:xx and this session already has two or more CHoCHs since its last BOS; skip.

5minute.reason: sideways day: an hour in, nothing has broken and the day range is narrow ("if ... no breaks then it's sideways")
5minute.expected: skipped SETUPs come from narrow, break-less sessions and average a loss; kept SETUPs from days that broke keep the runners
5minute.reading: At least 12 bars (one hour) into the session, no BOS today and the session range so far is at most 3 ATR; skip.
